summary: Well-designed, preregistered confirmatory experiment testing template-based input sanitization and deterministic verifier-gating in an LLM-driven NetOps pipeline. Execution artifacts and paired analysis are archived; primary paired McNemar test (n=141 pairs) reports a small but statistically detectable change in validator-accepted configurations (guarded − baseline ≈ +0.0426, p=0.03125). Key limitations: synthetic task bank, single model and validator, and an acknowledged preregistration language ambiguity (natural-language H1 vs. formal estimand).
critical_issues: Mandatory Disclosure Statement contains execution-log–level detail (per-file paths, many SHA‑256 hashes, verbatim counts) and reads like an artifact manifest rather than a concise disclosure; this duplicates archived provenance and violates the track’s requirement for a concise Disclosure Statement that does not duplicate run logs.

Citation semantics and bibliography presentation are not shown in machine-verified IEEE numbered form in the manuscript evidence bundle; the reviewer must verify that each numbered citation in the paper maps to a single verified bibliographic entry that actually supports the proximate claim.

The manuscript’s operational claim-space must be tightened: although the preregistration ambiguity is acknowledged, the paper must make explicit and prominent that the executed formal estimand measured validator acceptance-for-deployment (validator-valid = success), not a direct reduction in unsafe/attacker-success outcomes, and must avoid any wording that could be read as having tested the originally stated natural-language H1 without having executed its intended confirmatory analysis.
required_revisions: Condense the Disclosure Statement to a concise track-compliant form that (a) lists LLM(s) and model identifiers used, orchestration framework, master-prompt reference (SHA allowed), role boundaries (human Research Director selection vs. post-lock autonomous work), preregistration id and SHA, and an explicit statement that no human edited the manuscript after the autonomy lock; remove per-file paths, per-artifact SHA‑256 manifests, and execution-log verbatim content from the manuscript body (these may remain archived in the evidence bundle).

Replace any raw-URL/DOI-style in-text citation markers in the paper’s reference section and prose with standard IEEE numbered citations and ensure the manuscript’s numbered citations map exactly to the archived, verified bibliographic records; add a one-page (or supplementary machine-readable) citation-to-archive mapping file if necessary to make the mapping explicit.

Add an explicit, concise statement in Methods and Results (not only in Disclosure) that: (1) the formal binary outcome equals deterministic-validator acceptance-for-deployment, (2) the shared_initial_candidate generation semantics were used and therefore baseline and guarded conditions did not receive different first-pass sampled candidates when the shared_initial stage applied, and (3) the observed discordant pairs (n10=6) arose because sanitizer/repair activity changed the pipeline outcome post-generation — reference the archived paired_contingency_table.csv and the representative per-episode traces that illustrate this mechanism.

Include a short, self-contained sensitivity-summary paragraph (and numeric table row) in Results reporting the preregistered missingness-handling sensitivity analysis (i.e., the analysis treating missing generative outputs as failures and its effect on the point estimate, CI, and p-value). The numerical results are available in the archived analysis artifacts and must be summarized in the main paper rather than only in the archive.

Remove or rephrase any remaining prose that could be read as claiming confirmation of the preregistered natural-language H1 (reduction of unsafe/attacker-success) unless a confirmatory analysis targeting that formal unsafe-acceptance estimand is present; ensure conclusions are strictly bounded to the executed formal estimand and archived evidence.
optional_revisions: Round numeric displays in prose to sensible precision (e.g., report percentages to two decimal places) while keeping exact figures in tables/archival artifacts.

Add one short (≤2 paragraph) exemplar discordant-case vignette in Results (drawn from archived traces) to illustrate how sanitization/repair corrected a baseline rejection into a guarded acceptance — include only the minimal anonymized configuration snippet and a reference to the archived trace hash (not full artifact content).

If space permits, include a very small table listing the top-level verified bibliographic metadata (author, year, venue) for the 3–5 closest works to improve reader navigation (use numbered references as required).
